coder_notes: Population: conditions 'Glioma'; cohort A = recurrent grade II/III IDH-mutant glioma; cohort B = recurrent IDH-wildtype glioma (grade not stated) with HRR gene mutation. Glioblastoma not named anywhere -> not_glioblastoma (high_grade_glioma_unspecified also arguable; both exclude), flagged uncertain because cohort B would mostly be GBM under CNS5. Olaparib and temozolomide are registered as one 'Combination Product' but are two separate drugs (not a fixed-dose product) -> split into two rows, fixed_dose_combination false. Temozolomide given at a non-standard low dose (50 mg/m2 d1-7) as part of the tested triplet -> established_therapy_experiment (rule 3 exception i / rule 6); candidates are pembrolizumab and olaparib. HRR mutation enrichment in cohort B matched to olaparib (PARP inhibitor). Primary outcome ORR is for cohort A only; cohort B analysed descriptively.
